body:
🟠📝 **Fix · docs: The hook's JSDoc is now orphaned above the new `askedKeys` block**

The new `askedKeys` comment and constant were added between `useFloatingReadyCard`'s JSDoc (lines 10–15, "Ask main to float … once per arrival") and the function (line 29). The hook's doc now sits above another JSDoc and attaches to nothing, so editors show the `askedKeys` text, or nothing, on hover for `useFloatingReadyCard`. Move `askedKeys` and `__resetFloatingReadyCardForTests` above the hook's comment so that comment sits directly on line 29 again.

🟡🐛 **Consider · bug: An in-app fallback card disappears when the page remounts on the same history entry**

`fallbackFor` is component state, but `askedKeys` is now module-wide. Here is the sequence: the floating window fails (main answers false, which happens more often now because of the new 3 s timeout and the load-failure paths), so the page shows the in-app card. The user then goes to Export or the editor and comes Back. The page remounts on the same key with `fallbackFor` null. Line 33 returns early because the key is already in `askedKeys`, so `inApp` stays false and the card is gone without being dismissed. That goes against the doc's promise that the card is "never lost". One option is to record the outcome per key (asked / fell back) in the module map and start `fallbackFor` from it, for example `useState(() => fellBack.has(request?.key) ? request.key : null)`.

🟡📝 **Consider · docs: "Offers Open" applies only to a single import**

This says that if the user leaves Export while the copy runs, "a toast says the video is in the Library and offers **Open**". In `use-prepare-import.ts:60-70`, that is true only when one video came in. With several, the toast is `importedMany` (a count) and has no Open action. Suggested wording: "one video: a toast with **Open**; several: a count".

> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude Opus 5.5 responding on behalf of Cristian Sotomayor**

Fixed in [`059807d1`](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/commit/059807d1ac36c5afc049a02fee04c37cdb201837): `askedKeys` and its reset now sit above the hook's comment, so that JSDoc is on `useFloatingReadyCard` again.

> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude Opus 5.5 responding on behalf of Cristian Sotomayor**

Fixed in [`059807d1`](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/commit/059807d1ac36c5afc049a02fee04c37cdb201837): which entries fell back is now kept module-wide too (`fellBackKeys`), and `inApp` reads it, so a remount on the same entry shows the in-app card again without asking main. A new hook test covers Back after a fallback.

> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude Opus 5.5 responding on behalf of Cristian Sotomayor**

Fixed in [`0f88cb3e`](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/commit/0f88cb3e295770ce3226f501dd3cc5972667e7f3): the doc now says one video gets a toast with **Open**, and several get a count.

The stored `exportDestination` reaches only the Library cards (through `copyDestinationOf`). The finished rows just below still call `destinationOfPreset(copy.export!.preset)`, so an Email copy's row changes from "Email · anywhere" while it runs to "Slack · Discord" with the chat logo once it finishes. The master page's "Copies from this original" panel has the same gap, which means step 11 of the test plan ("the master page still says Email") does not hold.

<details><summary>Technical details</summary>

````markdown
# Stored copy destination is not read on Recent exports or the master page

## Affected sites
- apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/recent-exports.tsx:67 — finished rows use `destinationOfPreset(copy.export!.preset)` for the logo and `EXPORT_NAME`
- apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/components/master-copies-panel.tsx:83 — `destinationName(presetId)` derives the name from the preset
- apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/components/master-copies-panel.tsx:202 — `CopyIcon` derives the logo from the preset

## Required outcome
- A copy whose sidecar stored `exportDestination: "email"` reads as Email (name and logo) in Recent exports and in the master copies panel, as it already does on the Library card.
- Copies without a stored destination keep today's preset-based fallback.
- YouTube 1440p / 4K suffixes in `destinationName` keep working.

## Suggested approach
- Use `copyDestinationOf(copy)` for finished copies in both places. For the master panel, pass the resolved `DestinationId` into `destinationName` / `CopyIcon` alongside the preset (the preset is still needed for the resolution suffix and `factsOf`).
- Add a test case with `export: { preset: "balanced", …, destination: "email" }` to `master-copies-panel.test.tsx` and to the Recent exports test in `export-page.test.tsx`.
````

</details>

Nit: this block landed between `useFloatingReadyCard`'s JSDoc (lines 10–15) and the hook. Two doc comments now sit in a row above `askedKeys`, and the hook has none, so hovering it in the editor shows nothing. Moving `askedKeys` and `__resetFloatingReadyCardForTests` above that JSDoc fixes it.
